title: Stacked List
description: Stacked records in one card composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Card, Avatar, Badge, Button, Skeleton and Alert primitives: one row per item with an avatar, a name and a secondary line, a status badge, a muted meta line and a View action, with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the header lines up and each View button moves beside its record at @sm, the badge and meta move to a trailing column at @md and share one line at @lg.
